slide_title: Matrix Notation for Linear Regression and Classification (N- Samples)

bullets: Where: X_{N x d+1} is a matrix

layout.arrangement: Title spans the top in red with 'Matrix' in blue; slide number '17' in a yellow circle at top-right; small green squiggle annotations under the title at top-left and near top-right.
